name: Yuuki Setsuka
source:
Adopted daughter of [url=/c26034]Yuuki Ran[/url] from Milkyway 2.

This also makes her the adopted niece of [url=/c19595]Nanase Rin[/url] (formerly [url=/c20235]Yuuki Rin[/url]), the older sister of Ran.

This makes her the adopted cousin of Rin's daughter [url=/c20360]Nanase Kira[/url].
